title: tabernaemontana ceratocarpa
intro: Tabernaemontana ceratocarpa, commonly known as the Banded Tabernaemontana, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for various purposes, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana ceratocarpa include its ability to exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
